newsitem.title: UK: British Gas says not in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: British Gas says not in merger talks.

text.p: British Gas, which will hive off its trading arm into a separate company next week, said on Wednesday it was in no merger talks with any party.

The comment follows market speculation that Centrica, the new gas trading firm, would be a likely takeover target for companies aiming to expand their presence in Britain's gas and electricity markets.
"We are not talking to anybody about anything," chairman Richard Giordano told journalists after an extraordinary meeting in which shareholders approved the company's demerger.
The break-up becomes effective on Monday when trading will start in shares of Centrica and BG Plc, the re-named British Gas rump.
"Grey" market trading in both shares already started on Monday. But Giordano said a lot more trading days were needed "before we understand the values of the two shares relative to each other."
